# Resolved Questions

The archive of settled creative forks, moved here from open-questions.md when a
`D-nnnn` resolution lands (schema: same `## Q-nnnn` blocks; placement enforced by
V10). Context and option history are preserved as the decision record.

## Q-0001 — What is the series title?
- status: resolved
- resolved-by: D-0143
- raised: 2026-07-05
- parked: 2026-07-06 — deliberately deferred until more writing exists (D-0110); front-runner on record: "The Mending Way". Market facts on record for the revisit: "The Wyrd Way" is empirically blocked (two active same-name podcasts, domain taken, saturated Wyrd-field) though the search-forgiveness instinct itself was validated (platform fuzzy matching covers weird→wyrd); cleanest unclaimed strings found: "The Kindly Fen", "The Slow Thaw", "The Waymending", "The Mended Ground" (RQ-005-title-round-002.md).
- context: "The Iron Ledger" was invented by the Gemini agent for its lit-agent pitch and was never ratified as a title. As the in-world name of the imperial legal framework it is provisional (D-0072); as the show's title it is undecided.
- options:
  - keep The Iron Ledger
  - draw from Wyrd/Frith/thread lore
  - something else entirely

## Q-0008 — Human variance scheme
- status: resolved
- resolved-by: D-0118
- raised: 2026-07-05
- context: D-0058 requires comprehensible human variance without fantasy races. The session's triad (Chalk-Blooded / Bog-Touched / Liminals) is AI-proposed and unconfirmed; Jeff explicitly flagged "Not sure we're doing monster proxies" about Liminal-style figures. See [[human-variance]]. (D-0105 since resolved the in-principle half: liminal-style figures and magical animals are IN, with a demand for nuanced anomaly-manifestation.)

The sharper live fork = HOW liminality works (full detail in docs/rulings/):
  - A. inherited proximity — a heritable mark from generations at fouled human/landvættir edges
  - B. debt-written — axiomatic debt writes a person the way it sours a spring; a spectrum [rec core]
  - C. treaty-touched — the cost/gift of deep treaty with a landvættir; sacred to natives, witchery to the empire
  - D. vessel-adjacent — the Tithe's byproduct, tying liminals to the protagonist's Archive
  - E. sensory-liminal — Wyrd-given co-processor senses (the "weather-witch"); ties to the apprentice's craft
